cat >> journal.md <<'EOF'

## [2026-06-11 13:20] — instruction tuning (SFT) phase with instruct SLERP tournament

**TL;DR:** Added src/mythosmini/training/sft.py and a train.py sft_phase: after the pretraining SLERP champion, the model is instruction-tuned on data/sft.jsonl (951 ChatML-rendered tool-use conversations, 15,485 blocks at seq 512), one checkpoint per epoch, then a second SLERP tournament over {champion + instruct checkpoints} produces merges/instruct_champion.pt. 190 tests pass, lint/pyaot clean. Full 2B verification run relaunched with the complete pipeline.

**Long description:** User supplied the ChatML chat template and data/sft.jsonl; each record carries a pre-rendered `text` field, so the byte-level model trains on it directly (no template engine needed in-repo). Module functions: load_sft_texts (validates every line has non-empty text; FileNotFoundError/ValueError on bad data), build_sft_blocks (byte_tokenize + EOS per conversation, split into seq_len+1 blocks, EOS-padded final block, conversations never mixed within a block), run_sft (NAdamW, constant lr 1e-4, 3 epochs, micro 64, loops fixed 4, grad clip, shuffled per-epoch order, checkpoint per epoch at steps 90000+100*epoch), save_sft_checkpoint (same payload schema as training/STM checkpoints so benchmark/SLERP consume them unchanged). train.py: sft_phase runs after report_final on the pretraining champion, benchmarks each instruct checkpoint, reuses run_tournament with the champion included as a candidate, saves instruct_champion.pt, and main prints "instruct results:" with the final placement; missing data file = printed skip, not a crash, so runs without SFT data still complete. Pipeline e2e extended: writes a 2-row sft fixture, patches SFT_DATA_PATH, asserts sft phase output, 3 sft checkpoints, instruct champion file. Real-data validation: 951 texts -> torch.Size([15485, 513]) blocks. Also fixed two E501s by extracting ChatML marker variables in the e2e fixture, and reverted an out-of-scope ruff pass I mistakenly applied to pyaot.py (lint scope is src/ tests/ ralph.py train.py only). The in-flight 2B run (old code, pre-SFT) was killed at ~7% training and relaunched as runs/ 13:18 with the full pipeline — only minutes lost since the 4% token cache was already built by the new recycling builder.

**What worked:** Sandbox-first: tests/test_sft.py (7 tests: text loading, missing file, missing text field, block shape/EOS/vocab-range, round-trip decode, empty input rejection, 2-epoch training with loss decrease + checkpoint schema) written and passing against the isolated module before train.py was touched. make lint LINT_OK, make pyaot 74 files 0 errors, fast suite 190 passed.

**What failed:** First make lint failed on 2 E501s in the e2e fixture strings (fixed by extraction) and on the docs audit for the five new functions (entries added). My ruff --fix/format on pyaot.py was out of scope — reverted via git checkout before commit.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept module, tests, train.py wiring, docs entries. Discarded the pre-SFT 2B run (runs dir from 13:0x, partial) and the pyaot.py reformat.

**Open questions / next steps:** SFT hyperparameters (3 epochs, lr 1e-4) are first-guess, untuned. The instruct tournament includes the base champion, so a net-harmful SFT cannot lose ground — worst case the champion re-wins. Full-pipeline 2B verification run in flight; scores.md row plus the user report on sparse+FP4 vs the 60.41 champion when it lands. node_modules/, package.json, data/ are untracked user artifacts — left alone.
